source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Match the names of employees against the State supplied list. Complete both columns below for your 'hit'.
3. Send your 'hit' report to State no later than 3 days of the incident.
4. Send the complete Incident Report to State. A weekly report is fine. It is important to include the cause of the injury.

Sample file format to use when emailing reportable workplace accidents to State:

Subject line: [MONTH-YEAR] - [Name of Company]

Sent from: [YOUR EMAIL ADDRESS]
Email body: Name
        Employee ID (optional)
        Date of injury
        Injury Description
        Cause of injury: see attached incident report for more detail

Example:

Subject: [OCTOBER-2023] - [YOUR COMPANY]

Send from: [YOUREMAIL@...]
Email body: Jack Brown
       12345
       10-02
